blocks.text: The peso touched ₱64.17 recently to the dollar. Inflation is running hot at 7.8%. Growth forecasts have been cut to 2.5 %. These are real numbers, and they mean real pain for real households — higher rice prices, higher power bills, pricier fares. Nobody disputes that.
